messages.subject: Last spot available introductory distance sampling training: 12-23 April 2021
parts:
There remains only one space 🪑 for the introductory distance sampling training workshop being held in April.  Perfect timing to develop (or refresh) your understanding of distance sampling principles ahead of the (northern hemisphere) field season.

Workshop dates are 12-23 April taking place 1500-1730 British Summer time.  Lecture, questions and practicals for the first two hours, the last half hour is optional discussion.  Analyses conducted using R facilitated by RStudio/Cloud.  Complete details and link to registration site at

https://workshops.distancesampling.org/intro-apr-2021.html

If you, or one of your colleagues, wishes to attend this workshop, I suggest you act quickly.  If you are not successful in garnering this last available place, send me an email and I will place you onto a notification list for the next workshop, tentatively scheduled for late July.

-- 
Eric Rexstad
Centre for Ecological and Environmental Modelling
University of St Andrews
